Vendored browser assets (no JavaScript build or CDN required):

- [Leaflet 1.9.4](https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js)
- [Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3](https://unpkg.com/leaflet.markercluster@1.5.3/dist/leaflet.markercluster.js)

Original licenses are included alongside these files. Only OpenStreetMap raster
tiles are fetched externally. Light and dark appearances are browser CSS filters
on those tiles, avoiding API keys and preserving attribution.
